# Paths whose changes cannot affect the build, lint or test results.
# Read by scripts/ci-skip-gate.sh in ci.yml's Gate job: CI skips only when EVERY
# changed file matches a line here. Anything unlisted runs the full matrix, so a
# new directory or config file is safe by default.
#
# One extended regex per line, matched against the repo-relative path.
# Blank lines and #-comments are ignored. Anchor each pattern with ^.
^docs/
^[^/]+\.md$
^\.(claude|agents|codex|cursor)/.*\.md$
